permitted_intended_use: Project-local modification, rigging and rendering for a commercial game using the specifically selected base geometry.
limitations: This is an unrigged anatomical base, not a finished MICA model.
MICA likeness, covered tactical costume, hair, sensor fins and weapon must follow approved ImageGen source art.
Do not use the bare anatomical base as a final player asset or imply it passed animation or visual review.
